Sanjay K: Quick sync — Acme wants a 4-week POC. Main asks: low-latency chat + summarization, bursty traffic pattern (short spikes), and strict cost cap of $4k/mo for the pilot. Can we firm up GPU sizing + token cost estimate?
Alex R: Thanks — can you paste expected per-user behavior? tokens per turn, avg turns, and typical concurrency during spikes?
Sanjay K: Sure — rough profile from pre-sales: avg prompt ~200 tokens, response ~400 tokens, median turns 3, so ~1800 tokens per session. Baseline traffic 10 RPS, spikes up to 90 RPS for ~1-2 minutes when product demos run. Spikes nightly.
Maria P: Noted. Their procurement flagged the $4k budget — we'll try to stay under that for infra + hosted usage. They're ok with Dedicated if it helps predictability but prefer hosted if costs fit.
Emily Z: Model choice matters a lot for tokens and GPU. What model are we proposing? Llama-2-13B or a 7B distilled variant? Also do they need streaming?
Sanjay K: They asked for quality comparable to Llama-2-13B; prefer to start with 13B on q4 quant to balance cost/latency. Streaming is required for chat UX.
Alex R: Cool. Quick back-of-envelope: assume 13B q4 fwd performance — p50 token latency ~6ms/token on A100-80GB with batching. But spikes mean batching benefits drop. For 90 RPS with avg 600 tokens generated per request => 54k tokens/sec peak. That's huge if fully generated during spike. However real spikes are short and prefix caching + early exit help.
Emily Z: I'll put together two scenarios: steady (10 RPS) and burst (90 RPS). Also include a fallback plan: route spikes to a smaller model (7B) or use token cap during demo windows.
Alex R: Sketch of capacity: steady 10 RPS * 600 tokens = 6k tokens/sec — fits easily on 1x A100 with good batching. Peak 54k tokens/sec — needs ~9x the steady throughput if batching not effective. That suggests either autoscale to ~8-10 GPUs for peak or use a routing policy to divert spikes to a cheaper variant.
Sanjay K: They will not accept 8-10 GPUs in POC (procurement/noise). Can we simulate peak handling with mixed routing so we only need 2-3 GPUs but keep perceived latency acceptable?
Emily Z: Yes — options: 1) Keep 1-2 A100 as primary for production-quality responses and spill overflow to 1-2 A10/A5000 instances running 7B for degraded but acceptable results. 2) Use aggressive prefix caching for repeated demo prompts. 3) Limit demo sessions to shorter max tokens during peak.
Maria P: For the $4k budget: if hosted per-token cost ~ $0.0006/token for 13B (estimate) the token bill alone for heavy usage could exceed budget during demo spikes. We need a blended estimate with routing.
Alex R: I'll produce a cost table (rough) — scenario A (no routing): token cost for a 1-week heavy-demo period (10 spikes/day * 2 min * 54k tokens/sec) balloons. Scenario B (mixed routing): assume 60% of peak tokens served by 7B at $0.0002/token and 40% by 13B at $0.0006/token. That gets closer to budget.
Emily Z: Also include infra amortized cost: Dedicated A100 slot ~ $X/day (we'll put concrete numbers in the doc). For POC, recommend temporary Dedicated with 2x A100 + 1x A10 for overflow + routing rules — gives predictable latency for normal ops and controlled degradation on spikes.
Sanjay K: Action items please: 1) Alex — short cost estimate (token + infra) with 2 scenarios. 2) Emily — latency & GPU sizing sketch + fallback routing config snippet. 3) Maria — flag procurement/contract implications if Dedicated required. Need these by EOD for customer call tomorrow.
Alex R: On it. I'll use the conservative token cost and include a best-case with caching.
Emily Z: Draft of fallback routing snippet (pseudo):
```
route_policy:
  - if region.capacity < 0.7: route_to: 7B-quant
  - else: route_to: 13B-q4
  - burst_window: 120s
  - demo_profile: true
  - cache_prefixes: ['/demo_template_1', '/demo_template_2']
```
I'll also attach expected p50/p95 latencies per GPU type in the doc.
devops-bot: Deployment link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/pocs/ACME-2024 (pipeline last-run: 2053456775) :rocket:
Alex R: I'll drop estimates in the shared spreadsheet and ping here.
Maria P: Thanks team — if we can keep the POC predictable within $4k we'll push for hosted + routing. Otherwise start procurement for Dedicated trial.
Sanjay K: Great — appreciate the rapid turnaround. I'll add the customer constraints in the sheet and mark the call at 09:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
